neighbours.label: intercessory prayer: 'pray', 'prayer(s)' and the 'for' that names who is prayed for
fire: It has been a hard month, and we would really appreciate your prayers.
Please join us in prayer for the families affected by the flood.
I told my grandmother that I would pray for her every night.
The whole congregation prayed fervently for the missing fishermen.
We ask you to remember our missionaries in your prayers this week.
The church held an evening of prayer for the sick and the lonely.
She lit a candle and prayed for her son serving overseas.
Thank you all for praying for my father during his surgery.
quiet: It has been a hard month, and we would really appreciate your help.
Please join us at the hall to support the families affected by the flood.
I told my grandmother that I would call her every night.
The whole village searched tirelessly for the missing fishermen.
We ask you to remember our missionaries in your letters this week.
The church held an evening of music for the sick and the lonely.
She lit a candle and waited up for her son serving overseas.
Thank you all for visiting my father during his surgery.
